10328660_68b9dda4.text: While the expression of EGFP-LI within the various cell bodies of the hypothalamus reflected previous in situ hybridization (Wagner et al., 1996)(Roselli et al., 1998) and aromatase activity findings (Roselli et al., 1989)(Roselli et al., 1985), there was frequently a high density of EGFP-LI outside cell bodies, whose distribution corresponded to fibres or terminals. We suspect that these EGFP-ir fibres/ terminals may reflect fibre projections originating from the BST and medial amygdala (Pardo-Bellver et al., 2012) to the various hypothalamic nuclei, in particular, e.g. the medial preoptic nucleus/area, and the premammillary, medial tuberal and supraoptic nuclei, which contained the highest density of EGFPir fibres.
